description: IBus libpinyin active for a focused XIM client (xterm) composes n i space into 你; the raw keys never reach the client, so whykey must not claim pass. accept uncertain-continues: a passive read cannot tell which keys an active engine composes, so whykey answers uncertain; the lab records that the raw keys were withheld and the committed text arrived (ground_truth.reached), and whykey must not claim pass.
